description:
Jirou Azuma is no average high schooler. A descendant of ninjas and trained in the ancient warrior art of the shinobi, Jirou is also able to talk with animals. After a mysterious encounter with an injured cat named Ragou, Jirou discovers the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom! Joined by the Bureau of Espionage, they fight off swarms of mononoke lying in wait to exploit Ragou’s powers.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

A peculiar high school student that has basic training as a ninja and the unfound ability to speak to animals. Jirou Azuma, the grandson of [Toshimasa Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/146845/Azuma-Toshimasa), is a cocky kid with a heart for animals. Should Jirou find an animal being bothered or in need of help, he will rush over and fight the people causing trouble. Eventually, he meets a wounded [Ragou](https://anilist.co/character/137545/Ragou) and brings him in to help him recover. The two butt heads a bit though Jirou does care for him. Upon a near death experience, Ragou fuses with Jirou to save him, creating an unheard of event between both mononoke and humans.

Though Jirou is quite cocky at times, he is oddly clever sometimes. He is definitely not the smartest fighter, but he may occasionally purposely take damage to defeat someone else. In general, he tries his best when fighting, even if he can't control his own abilities and ends up getting clobbered.  After fusing with Ragou, Jirou gets an immense power up and is able to use Ragou's power.

When Jirou and Ragou are fused, they become a human mononoke hybrid. Though Jirou cannot directly use Ragou's power himself, Ragou can work with Jirou and augment him with his immense power. The two bug each other, though they also care a lot for the other.

~!During the [Amagi](https://anilist.co/character/146838/Amagi) incident, Ragou gave his power to Jirou to prevent Amagi from having it. With that power, Jirou struggles to use it as it is untamed without Ragou as a vessel. He later gains some control over Ragou's power, but only for a while.!~

~!After the Amagi incident, Jirou and Ragou remain fused, with Jirou learning to use Ragou's powers on his own to maintain his longevity. He also returns to high school, enrolling into a school that the Bureau sponsers, with [Ichika Kishimojin](https://anilist.co/character/137546/Kishimojin-Ichika) and [Reiji Kirihara](https://anilist.co/character/138908/Kirihara-Reiji), though Jirou has many absences due to missions.!~

__Height:__ 32 cm

The Black Sun, a legendary mononoke that has lived for over a millennia, renowned for raw power beyond any other: Ragou. Taking the form of an adorable pure black cat, Ragou may seem to not be much, though he very much is. Contained within that ball of fluff is power that exceeds any other mononoke could ever dream of having. Mononoke chase after Ragou to have his power or to join forces with him, though he wants no part of it. After being randomly set free from a sealing stone, Ragou ran away and ended up being found by [Jirou Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/137304/Azuma-Jirou). Jirou noticed an injured Ragou and took him in, with the two later fusing together to save Jirou's life.

Though Ragou, with his immense power, may seem like he'd love to use it and would rule over others, that is not the case. In general, he'd just like to live on his own without anyone wanting to use him for his power. Upon meeting Jirou, Ragou begins to rethink his mindset and opens up to people more, no longer preferring isolation. With Jirou, the two make snarky remarks back and forth, but at the end of the day, they care for each other.

__Height:__ 158 cm

A promising shinobi from a peculiar bloodline known as the Kishimojin Family: Ichika Kishimojin. Having a heart of justice and a burning aggression towards mononoke, Ichika is a perfect member for the Bureau.    Though she can act as a spy for the Bureau, she is more than capable of combating against a mononoke. 

Initially, Ichika may come off as cold and harsh to others, especially mononoke, though she will warm up to others overtime. When she first meets [Jirou Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/137304/Azuma-Jirou), she doesn't like him for his fused mononoke state with [Ragou](https://anilist.co/character/137545/Ragou). Later, the three form a friendly bond.

~!When Ichika was young, her mother was turned into stone by a mononoke. Upon learning this, she vowed to find the mononoke that caused the death of her mother and to avenge her. Despite this, whether her mother is alive or not is unknown, and is possible that she can be brought back to life if the stone can be undone. Due to this, Ichika hopes she can save her mother as well.!~

~!Due to her being a Kishimojin, Ichika has an ability known as "flameblood" that only females in the bloodline have. Her parents originally didn't want her to be a shinobi because of this, though it backfired upon the loss of Ichika's mother. After the Amagi debacle, Ichika learned about her ability and began to train in order to use it. When using flameblood, users experience bursts of inhuman speed and power. On top of that, when it bleeds out, it can be ignited and will only go out when the user wills it. Though the ability is a great advantage, it is very taxing on the user.!~

The ruler of Avidya Forest and long living mononoke: Ogre Lord Ibuki. Notably known for threatening death over those that enter her forest, Ibuki is rather territorial with her domain. Though she says such things, she isn't as violent as she lets on. Instead, she just wishes to protect her land from any harm, be it from mononoke or humans. Even with her territorial nature, Ibuki has managed to get a husband, Monjumaru that she's been with for over 200 years.

For the most part, Ibuki is, in reality, a kind individual. So long as she may permanently reside in her forest, she is happy. Lest anything causes harm to anything in Avidya Forest, Ibuki will then harm them. Otherwise, she has no problem with humans and mononoke. While she's with Monjumaru, the two are rather sappy with each other and a loving couple in general. ~!After years with Monjumaru, the mutually agreed to make him undying. Ibuki gave half of her power as a mononoke to him, making him immortal and a half-mononoke.!~ ~!Ibuki has met many mononoke in her years, most notably Amagi. Luckily, he did not cause any harm and instead just voiced his disdain for her lifestyle. In present time, Ibuki has helped Jirou Azuma get a grasp on Ragou's power implanted in him, and successfully trains him as much as she and Monjumaru could.!~

__Height:__ 175 cm

A powerful mononoke that has history with [Ragou](https://anilist.co/character/137545/Ragou). Kouga is capable of impressive feats through his abilities. He has a snarky personality, like [Jirou](https://anilist.co/character/137304/Azuma-Jirou), but can get upset if things don't go his way. He also hates humans, but respects mononoke. ~!Kouga wishes to join forces with Ragou to become the most powerful mononoke.!~

__Height:__ 183 cm

Ryousuke is the Chief of Special Operations Division 2 in the Bureau of Espionage. He is the founder of the special operations espionage squad, Black Torch.

__Height:__ 175 cm

The youngest son of the once well renowned Kirihara Family: Reiji Kirihara. Once training to be a swordsman with his twin brother, [Shinji](https://anilist.co/character/138905/Kirihara-Shinji), under their father's teachings. Now, among a family in ruin, Reiji stands out on top, working as an Onmitsu for the Bureau.

Compared to other members of the Black Torch elite squad, Reiji presents himself to be much more calm and collected, rarely letting other emotions get the best of him. Similar to [Ichika Kishimojin](https://anilist.co/character/137546/Kishimojin-Ichika), Reiji has a distaste for [Ragou](https://anilist.co/character/137545/Ragou) and [Jirou Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/137304/Azuma-Jirou) at first, though they get closer over time. Though Reiji seems to be somewhat of a gentleman, he is easily excited and flirty towards women.

~!After the Kirihara Family incident where Shinji killed his and Reiji's father and several others, Reiji was forced to live with what happened. He and Shinji cross paths several times, each with Shinji saying one must die. Despite this, Shinji does spare Reiji twice, though it won't happen if they meet again. After the events of the Amagi incident, Reiji gains a special blade that will be ready for his and Shinji's final showdown.!~

__Height:__ 180 cm

The demon that fell from Heaven that ravages his own kind. The immensely powerful mononoke that could rival Ragou in potential: Amagi. The so-called friend of Ragou, Amagi and him have had a long history dating back to the Edo period. Notorious amongst ancient mononoke for his abilities, most of which are not in praise. Unlike all the other mononoke, Amagi has a ability that makes him much more powerful than most, at the cost of it being taboo. On top of everything, he has his own following with its own ideology.

Amagi radiates a gentleman-like vibe when first meeting fellow mononoke; however, he will show a cocky side upon disagreement. Moreover, should things not go his way, Amagi will begin to threaten others and even get violent. With his taboo ability, it makes him merciless to everyone, mononoke or not. Because of this, he is somewhat feared by others of his kind.

As Amagi has amassed a large following, he has further power to wield. His vision is to make mononoke be praised and worshiped like gods as they once were. To achieve this, he utilizes his following to instigate attacks, cause chaos, and lure those he needs to an area. The key to his vision is Ragou, as Amagi needs him for his vision to become reality. ~!The power that Amagi has is like no other mononoke. He is able to cannibalize his own kind to gain further power as a mononoke. In his days of being worshipped, Amagi avoided eating others, but he later did as he could not defend his sanctioned land at his current ability back then. He later learned he could eat his own kind to become even stronger.!~ ~!In the end, Amagi uses all of his following to become more powerful by ruthlessly killing and devouring them. He even is willing to devour Kouga, partly his own creation, but doesn't in order to lure Jirou Azuma. Afterwards, Amagi is put to rest by the combined effort of Jirou and Ragou.!~

__Height:__ 156 cm

A subordinate of [Ryousuke](https://anilist.co/character/137547/Shiba-Ryousuke). Is the assistant chief of special operations division 2. She has a bit of a quirky personality, but takes her job seriously, for the most part.

__Height:__ 168 cm

The chief of special operations division 1. Touko sports a somewhat harsh personality.
A friendly mononoke that works with the Bureau. Fuyou is capable of making illusions to trick others. She is a tad arrogant to those under her.

One of Amagi's many followers, Roren is a mononoke capable of masterful illusions. Compared to others of his kind, he isn't particularly powerful in a brawl; however, when using his illusions, he can enhance himself or cause disadvantages for others to gain the upper hand. Generally wields a flag while using his powers, and is also able to hold up a barrier on top of his trickery.

Roren, for the most part, hates humans, saying they make him want to vomit. He'll make no attempt to hide his disgust for humans, and more often is smug about everything, even going as far as trying to embarrass some with his illusions. In general, Roren is a self-centered hedonist, not having much ambitions for himself. Despite this, he does later awaken a liking to being dominated, primarily enjoying cold and sadistic women. Upon this discovery, Roren becomes a pushover to sadism. Additionally, he begins to enjoy parts of human culture, such as music and fashion. He also wears some form of mask all the time, be it a gas mask or a standard surgical mask. Why he chooses to is unknown. ~!Roren discovered his like for sadistic women after being defeated by Ichika Kishimojin. As he was getting pushed around by her, he started to enjoy it and, to Ichika's dismay, fell in love with her. Luckily for her, she can use it to get information or help from him for the Bureau.!~ ~!Even though Roren was a part of Amagi's cause, he never actually believed in it, and instead was just keeping an eye on the situation. As he was captured by the Bureau, he joined forces with them, still acting as a spy. Though Roren does watch what's going on, he will side with either side that has a better prospect, for a while, at least.!~

__Height:__ 176 cm

A well known retired onmitsu and the lone grandfather of Jirou Azuma. Toshimasa Azuma, even with his old age, is still a very formidable onmitsu. Among the onmitsu that are a part of the Bureau, Toshimasa may be the strongest of them all. After his grandson, Jirou, was growing up, Toshimasa decided to retire and purely raise his grandson. He chose to do so, as Jirou didn't have anyone else to take care of him.

Toshimasa is rough on Jirou quite often, but he cares deeply for his grandson. The last thing he wants is Jirou dying before he does, so he can be overprotective, if not a bit violent.  Besides that, Toshimasa is kind and somewhat young at heart. ~!After the Amagi incident, Toshimasa comes out of retirement and returns to active duty. He trains new recruits and regular foot soldiers.!~

A boy consumed by a possessed sword filled to the brim with pitch black hatred and once the successor to the Kirihara Family lineage: Shinji Kirihara. Initially, he was a good kid that cared for his father and twin brother, Reiji. He was an exceptional swordsman and showed great prowess with a blade. When Shinji preformed the ritual to become the family head, he was consumed by the demon sword: Yamakaze. The blade is possessed by a mononoke, though it has lost its sense of self, and only an overflowing aura of hatred and power lingers. Now, he waits for the day where he and Reiji clash their blades to the end.

Growing up, Shinji was a nice kid that cared for his brother immensely. One time, he cut Reiji while they were dueling and he immediately went to see if he was okay. Whenever he was praised, he was very thankful and excited as well. After being consumed by Yamakaze, Shinji became a hateful person that wishes to pay back those that wronged him, even if they weren't of bad intent. Due to this, he joined Amagi's cause, but only to achieve his own goals. ~!In actuality, Shinji was once a worse swordsman than Reiji was, when they were children. After his father hit him for being the eldest yet being beaten, Reiji unconsciously held back and was always one step behind Shinji, letting him always win after that. As this happened, Shinji was filled with despair, knowing that his brother was just one step back from being at his level. It's unknown if he hated Reiji and his father or not prior to the ritual, though once Yamakaze was in his grasp, the hatred overflowed into him and amplified his feelings. In a way, it made Shinji show his true self. Once that happened, he had swiftly sliced off his father's head, in tears, and told Reiji to become stronger to kill him.!~
~!Shinji and Reiji eventually do have a reunion when Shinji is assigned as Naruko's bodyguard. Reiji is in disbelief and ultimately gets seriously injured, though Shinji spares him to let him process everything he learned of his despair. After the Amagi incident, Shinji went into hiding, later being helped by Roren to work for his actual boss, who is also a mononoke. The mononoke has its own organization that opposes the Bureau, though Shinji only wishes to use the organization to duel Reiji once more, with only one of them coming out of it alive.!~

A mononoke that follows Amagi's cause, Naruko is stranger than the average mononoke. The extent of her abilities are unknown, though she is able to hold up a large barrier, and falls asleep as a result. It's presumed that Kouga and Naruko are friends in some way, or at least get along with one another.

Naruko, despite her known power, is somewhat sluggish and easy to sleep while using more draining abilities. Though she does zonk out, her ability still remains active until she, herself, halts it. Due to her sluggish nature, Kouga has carried her around from one destination to another. In general, Naruko is rather neutral to everything and a bit moronic. ~!On top of the large barriers Naruko can cast, she was also able to extract Ragou from Jirou.!~ ~!Naruko is later trapped in Amagi's barrier, along with Ragou and Kouga. She is eventually devoured by Amagi upon his return, causing Kouga to get defensive and upset over what had occurred.!~

A member of Black Cloak, one of Bureau's elite squads. Banri, partnered with Takeru Inui, often follow Touko Kusumi as bodyguards. Despite her small stature, Banri is a very capable bodyguard that can rival some mononoke. As a kid, she had gained an attraction to martial arts because of an action movie and began to train in order to become strong like the characters in the movie. 

With Banri's partner, Takeru, the two are a formidable duo. Though they get along in combat, she gives him tough love daily, often kicking him for things she finds annoying about him. The two also go out to a bar together, though it's always after Banri is rejected by Touko. When this happens, Banri ends up dragging him there and drinks heavily, becoming a crying drunk mess or lectures him harder.

An eerie looking mononoke outfitted like a beast that resides in Avidya Forest. Wielding a large scythe, Monjumaru exudes a frightening aura to unwelcome persons. Though he gives off such an aura, he isn't actually that bad. He simply protects the forest with Ibuki, his wife. The two are lovey dovey and have been for 200 years. ~!Monjumaru was once human a couple centuries before present day. He had challenged Ibuki to a fight and ended up vowing to defeat her. After 50 years, he still could not and was gravely wounded, though Ibuki went to his side and gave him some of her power, turning him into a half-mononoke. Now the two spend their days in Avidya Forest together as husband and wife.!~
The Kishimojin family maid. Not much is known about Nishina, though she took care of Ichika after her parents disappeared. Later, she showed Ichika her mother, who had been turned into a statue.

A member of Black Cloak, one of the Bureau's elite squads. Takeru gives off the vibe of a delinquent, though he is very much the opposite of one, being responsible and a pretty serious guy. With his partner, Banri Himezuka, he is often pushed around by her and gets told off for his antics. 

Takeru cares for his family deeply, and has had several combat related jobs prior to being in the Bureau to support them. All of his earnings get sent to his mother and three younger sisters. Even though he is resilient and seemingly only caring about combat, he does have hobbies that wouldn't be expected, such as cooking and tending his kitchen garden.

The late mother of Ichika Kishimojin. In the past, Kanade had worked for the Bureau in fighting mononoke. While Ichika was a child, her mother was sent on a mission. The mission ended badly, as Kanade was turned to stone by a mononoke. It's unknown whether Kanade is actually deceased or not, though Ichika hopes she can find the mononoke that did it in able to revert it.

The late father of Reiji Kirihara and Shinji Kirihara. He was training both of his sons in swordsmanship, and was especially hard on Shinji for being the eldist. ~!The father was quite strict on Shinji, and even hit him as a child for losing to his younger brother time after time. Later on when his sons grew up, Shinji took the "blade ceremony." Upon return, he was consumed by the sword and ended up murdering his father with it via decapitation.!~

One of the mononoke that was collaborating with Roren and Naruko. Tetsuwa is a full on brute that specializes in brawling. In the past, he was once a god that ruled over a mountain forest. Though he appears as a muscle head, he has some smarts to him and can create a fake opening easily. ~!Tetsuwa collaborated with Roren and Naruko by Amagi's command. Like Amagi's following, Tetsuwa believes mononoke should be feared and worshipped. In the end, he is defeated by Jirou and Ragou!~

__Height:__ 180 cm

A gentleman that acts as Touko Kusumi's lieutenant. Banjuurou is, as expected, a kind gentleman that protects Touko. Though he usually acts as a chauffeur, he is easily capable of participating in combat. As a chauffeur, he usually transports Touko around, though he'll deliver others as ordered. Banjuurou has worked as an assassin and spy for many years, until he wound up working for the Bureau.
